name: core
description: Always-on working discipline for every project: report status and ETA for long-running tasks when they finish, fail, or stall, and tag each project with its categories so domain plugins such as research load only where they belong, put every web service a machine hosts behind one token-gated entry point, keep a shareable per-user GPU niceness counter for the shared behemoth box, chart every model call of the local coding agents like a stock, and run a fleet of agents, one per work item in its own worktree, from one coordinator chat.
